output.scope_note: This is a review of honeycomb layered oxides that reports room-temperature and 573 K ionic conductivities of Li-, Na- and K-based compounds in Table 2, so it is in scope, but every value is literature-cited and the table's column alignment is ambiguous, so only the one unambiguous row is recorded.

records.notes: Row from Table 2, a compilation of literature values (caption cites refs 59,64,90,126,173,249-252,254,255), so this is not a measurement in this paper. Column order is inferred: 3.8 × 10−2 is the 573 K value and ∼10−5 the 300 K value. The Ea column has no stated temperature range, and the pellet-compactness value (∼70) is stored as relative density. Mg is a constituent, not a dopant. Other rows were skipped because their multi-line alignment in the PDF text is ambiguous.
